text:
```yaml
name: Conventional Commits

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  lint-pr-title:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Validate PR title
        uses: dorny/gh-action-validate-pr-title@v1
        with:
          title-regex: '^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|perf|test|chore|build|ci|revert)(\([^\)]+\))?: .+'
          error-message: 'PR title must follow Conventional Commits format.'

  release-please:
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Release Please
        uses: googleapis/release-please-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          release-type: cpp
          target-branch: main
          path: .
```
